headline: Prates Next
caption:
Islam Makhachev vs. Carlos Prates is reportedly being lined up for UFC 336 in Toronto 🏆
Islam or Prates? 👇

Per MMA reporter Álvaro Colmenero, the UFC welterweight title fight is targeted for Jan. 30 at Scotiabank Arena, though nothing is official yet. Prates has knocked out all seven of his UFC opponents. UFC news.

Who takes it?
question: Islam or Prates?
